title: (a) little (a) few
summary: Слова little/a little для неисчисляемых и few/a few для исчисляемых: «немного, но есть» против «почти нет».
ru:
## (a) little и (a) few — «немного»
| слово | с чем | пример |
|---|---|---|
| **(a) little** | неисчисляемые | little water, a little time |
| **(a) few** | исчисляемые во мн. числе | few books, a few days |

## a little и a few — «немного, но есть»
Это **положительная** мысль: «что-то есть».
> She drank **a little** water. — Она выпила немного воды.
> I speak **a little** Spanish. — Я немного говорю по-испански.
> We're going away for **a few** days. — Мы уезжаем на несколько дней.
> — Are there any shops? — Yes, **a few**. — Магазины есть? — Да, несколько.

## little и few — «почти нет»
Без **a** значение **негативное**: «очень мало, почти нет».
> There was **little** food in the fridge. It was nearly empty. — В холодильнике почти ничего не было.
> There were **few** people in the park. — В парке почти никого не было.
Можно усилить: **very little**, **very few**.
> You make **very few** mistakes. — Вы делаете очень мало ошибок.

## Сравните
| положительно | отрицательно |
|---|---|
| **a little** money = есть немного | **little** money = почти нет |
| **a few** friends = есть пара друзей | **few** friends = почти нет друзей |
> I've got **a few** friends, so I'm not lonely. — У меня есть несколько друзей, мне не одиноко.
> I've got **few** friends. I'm lonely. — У меня почти нет друзей. Мне одиноко.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I have a few money.~~ → I have **a little** money. (money — неисчисляемое)
- ~~I have a little friends.~~ → I have **a few** friends.
- ~~I have few friends, so I'm not lonely.~~ → I have **a few** friends, so I'm not lonely. (few звучит грустно)
en:
## (a) little and (a) few
| word | with | example |
|---|---|---|
| **(a) little** | uncountable nouns | little water, a little time |
| **(a) few** | plural countable nouns | few books, a few days |

## a little and a few
These have a **positive** idea: some, not many.
> She drank **a little** water.
> I speak **a little** Spanish.
> We're going away for **a few** days.
> — Are there any shops? — Yes, **a few**.

## little and few
Without **a**, the idea is **negative**: nearly no / nearly nothing.
> There was **little** food in the fridge. It was nearly empty.
> There were **few** people in the park.
We can say **very little** and **very few**: *You make very few mistakes.*

## Compare
| positive | negative |
|---|---|
| **a little** money = some | **little** money = nearly none |
| **a few** friends = some | **few** friends = nearly none |
> I've got **a few** friends, so I'm not lonely. · I've got **few** friends. I'm lonely.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I have a few money.~~ → I have **a little** money.
- ~~I have a little friends.~~ → I have **a few** friends.
structure:
## Схема
| | неисчисляемые | исчисляемые (мн.) |
|---|---|---|
| немного (есть) | a little water | a few friends |
| почти нет | little water | few friends |
| очень мало | very little water | very few friends |

## Формулы
> **a little** / **little** + неисчисляемое существительное
> **a few** / **few** + существительное во мн. числе

## Краткие ответы
> — Do you want sugar? — Yes, **a little**, please.
> — Did you take any photos? — Yes, **a few**.

## Смысл
> **a** = положительно (есть); без **a** = отрицательно (почти нет)

items.text: — Have you got any money? — Yes, {{a little}}.
— Have you got any envelopes? — Yes, {{a few}}.
— Do you want sugar in your coffee? — Yes, {{a little}}, please.
— Did you take photos on holiday? — Yes, {{a few}}.
— Does your friend speak English? — Yes, {{a little}}.
— Are there any factories in this town? — Yes, {{a few}}.

exercises.title: Дополните предложение
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **a little** или **a few** и слово из скобки.

items.text: Last night I wrote {{a few}} {{letters}} to my family. (letters)
I'd like {{a little}} {{milk}} in my tea. (milk)
Open the window. I need {{a little}} {{air}}. (air)
I've got {{a few}} {{friends}} in this city. (friends)

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение с **a little / a few / little / few**.

items.prompt: (there / be / few / people / in the park)
answers: There are few people in the park.
There were few people in the park.
We're going away for a few days.
We are going away for a few days.
We went away for a few days.
We know a few people here.

items.prompt: В моей комнате почти нет мебели. (little)
answers: There is little furniture in my room.
There's little furniture in my room.
Please give me a little water.
Can I have a little water, please?
Give me a little water, please.
There are very few students here.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями. Проверьте по образцу.

items.sample: I have a few close friends.
I have little free time on weekdays.
I speak a little English and a few words of French.
